items.title: Narrow layouts
items.requirement: retain usable workspace width at 320, 390, 500, and 620 px.
steps: Launch the current editor renderer.
Mount the Financial Types fixture and select Invoice in Design.
Resize to 320, 390, 500, and 620 px; inspect the mobile mode selector, drawers, tabpanel width, and document overflow.
items.observedCurrentBehavior: Live probes reported zero document overflow and a tabpanel equal to the viewport width at all four requested widths; mobile mode and drawer controls were active.
items.satisfyingCurrentControlOrState: The current mobile mode selector plus on-demand Types and Inspector drawers already preserve the Design work lane.

items.title: Document reset
items.requirement: reset mode, scroll, expansion, selection, and graph state when another document opens.
steps: Mount the real-host relation fixture.
Open Graph.
Select the Source node and inspect the retained graph context.
items.observedCurrentBehavior: The capture establishes selected graph state, but a still cannot prove what is cleared when a second document opens.
items.testOrArchitectureEvidenceNeeded: Add an automated two-document lifecycle test that sets mode, scroll, disclosure, selection, graph camera/lens, opens document B, and asserts B starts from its own defaults.

items.title: Root selection
items.requirement: select and feature the declared `$root` when a document opens.

Open Design and inspect the type tree.
Select Invoice and inspect its root marker, checked Root control, and definition header.
items.observedCurrentBehavior: Invoice is visibly root-marked in the tree, its Root control is checked, and the cited current capture shows Invoice selected in Design.
items.satisfyingCurrentControlOrState: The existing root marker, checked Root control, selected tree row, and Invoice definition header satisfy the visible requirement.

items.title: Graph counts

Open Graph and choose the Relations lens.
Fit the atlas and inspect toolbar, graph summary, Details, and relation matrix.
items.observedCurrentBehavior: Graph reports one aggregate link total while the four edge kinds remain distributed across lenses and separate views.
items.smallestLiteralUiDelta: Replace the aggregate link count with four compact per-kind counts in the existing graph toolbar or Details metrics area.
